channel.title: Comments for page "Incident Log 555-1"
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "Incident Log 555-1"

item.title: Terrible.
item.content:encoded:
So let me get this straight. They refused him anesthetic or even opiates because it was "dangerous", but they were okay with cutting his throat open to stop his screaming? Who was the researcher in charge of this? Jigsaw? This isn't cold detached pragmatism this is just edgy torture porn. General anesthetic is safe when properly administered, opiates even moreso. Both much moreso than cutting someone's throat open. He was in so much pain he was trying to kill himself, and ridiculous levels of pain can actually kill you in and of itself.

By every single angle, the foundation's handling was utter nonsense. When someone goes through horrible suffering because it was legitimately and pragmatically the least terrible solution, that's fine. But that's not what's going on here.

item.title: Jesus Christ!
item.content:encoded: Just…Jesus Christ! This is the most horrible thing I've read happening to a D-class that still adheres to my headcanon of the Foundation being cold, but not cruel. They actually have a practical reason for keeping the poor bastard alive through all this. Well done.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
The guard shot the first Class-D, and the corpse adhered to the outside of the cabinet. The guard then shot the Class-D attacking Dr. ███████, and his corpse collided with the guard, causing his firearm to discharge. The shot ricocheted off the wall and struck Dr. ███████ in the head, killing him. The security guard was subsequently crushed by Dr. ███████'s corpse against the locker containing the SCP, collapsing it and killing him.

Really?

I mean it's possible, just not probable. Unless SCP containment breaches happen every week, I don't see how inane chain of events could, in all likelihoods, happen. Now maybe if the D-class managed to kill Dr. Blackboxes, That would be a bit more believable hmm?
